in_sanskrit.name: Batvansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bat - Lord, Vansh - Lineage
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Batvansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bat' and 'Vansh'. Bat refers to a Lord or God, while Vansh represents lineage or descent from a deity. Thus, Batvansh can be interpreted as 'Descendant of a Lord' or 'Lordly Lineage'.
